input.logical_elements: 64 uint8 binary voxels per beat; contiguous Z,Y,X
input.keep_and_strb: all 64 byte lanes asserted, including final physical word
input.last: 1 on final declared physical beat only

output.vertices: 8 packed uint64 Q1 XYZ words per beat; original binary Lewiner cell and triangle order
output.user: 1 on first output beat only, including footer-only frames

AXI_MM: unused; wrapper ties memory master outputs inactive
normal_host_policy: Validate dimensions and allocation budget before DMA. Count first, allocate exact output, then produce. Reject every nonzero status. Reuse the same input BO between passes.
abnormal_frame_policy: Consume configured input word budget, preserve fixed output length, report framing/count errors. Count/produce disagreement pads missing words and never exposes the failed output as a mesh.
invalid_scalar_policy: Drain min(input_words,2097152) then emit one footer. These diagnostic configurations are refused by the production host plan before DMA.
